component.name: PicoPOSSUM
component.summary: Offline-first Point of Sale & Inventory Management System

description.p: PicoPOSSUM is a local-first, offline Point of Sale (POS) and inventory management system tailored for small shops and retail stores.
Features include high-speed keyboard checkout, concurrent open bill drafts, live stock movement tracking, automated local backups, thermal receipt printing, sales reporting, and CSV migration tools.
Initial stable release of PicoPOSSUM desktop POS terminal.
